english.note: Use 整靚 as the all-purpose colloquial way to make a person, object, or place look better.
Use this colloquial phrase when emphasizing the result of making something look prettier.

examples.english: I’ll beautify the flat a bit.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 gaan1 uk1 zing2 leng3 di1

examples.english: I use a few lamps to adorn the whole living room, and it looks much prettier.
examples.traditional: 我用幾盞燈將成個客廳整靚晒。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 gei2 zaan2 dang1 zoeng1 sing4 go3 haak3 teng1 zing2 leng3 saai3
